title: cyclobalanopsis lineata var. fargesii
intro: Cyclobalanopsis lineata var. fargesii, commonly known as Farges' Chinese chestnut or Farges' chestnut, is a plant species in the family Fagaceae. It is a deciduous tree native to China, valued for its medicinal properties and edible nuts. The health benefits of Farges' Chinese chestnut include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial effects.
